Ready to Move Forward

The website is working!

17 September 2026 — in blog

I’m so happy to announce that the website is finally working. I’ve chosen to use Jekyll, which I’m new to so the coding is unfamiliar to me. I had a devil of a time getting things to work properly. Everytime I fixed an issue, it broke something else. I was getting close to giving up. But I didn’t and now I have a working, custom Jekyll website.

After much heartache and frustration, all sections of the website are working together.

The posts uploaded now are test posts or only part of a real post. All will be removed soon when I start to add the real posts. The website will start to fill out and look much better within a week or so.

Again, thank you for your patience.
